world.action_base: exact action_space.low; proposed action must satisfy full bounds; each rollout starts from a fresh environment initialized before any action
world.public_features: only flattened env.reset() structured observation, first 12 entries tanh clipped plus length/mean/std; task label, hidden simulator state, future reward and oracle unavailable to learners
world.reward: sum of actual env.step public rewards across at most 3 steps; no imagined oracle or reward substitution

cohorts.source_order: FIT collected first; checkpoint model then evaluate CHECK veto only; DEV used once and never for tuning; no seed replacement
cohorts.fit_trials: 2 families x 4 seeds x 4 arms = 32 public interaction rollouts; every method receives precisely the same raw train dataset
cohorts.check_trials: 2 families x 2 seeds x 5 fitted/fixed policies = 20 real rollouts
cohorts.dev_trials: picking 4 seeds x 5 policies = 20 real rollouts; reaching/pushing 2 seeds x 5 policies = 20 real rollouts

models.candidate: fast/slow selective episodic kernel reward memory updated only from FIT action-return observations; prediction error determines retained high-surprise exemplars (capacity 16) combined with slower all-FIT action averages
controls: fully fitted mean return per action
models.common_budget: identical FIT action/observation/reward experiences to every trainable policy; the exact same public observation vector and action menu for decision
models.model_evaluation: save learned states to JSON, reload before CHECK and DEV; prove predictions match bitwise pre/post reload; no reward feedback during validation/development

fixed_selection.metric: per-seed total observed public reward, larger is better
fixed_selection.decision: claim only a bounded DEVELOPMENT transfer improvement if candidate's mean unfamiliar picking reward exceeds the strongest fully fitted conventional comparator by at least 0.01, candidate not worse than best fitted control by more than 0.1 on CHECK or familiar DEV, no experiment failures, and full retention reproducibility; otherwise retain NO_GO
fixed_selection.resource: wall seconds, process CPU seconds, peak process RSS for complete FIT+CHECK+DEV, checkpoint bytes, trial counts
scientific_claims_not_allowed: first use accepted by FORGE FSA
